ThingDef.label: Charmer's Chip implant
ThingDef.description: Another coveted implant bestowed on the world by the Vacuous and then downgraded to be feasible for mass manufacture. This implant dramatically improves a user's charm. Apparently, it uses a sort of auxiliary AI to control subtle expressions, body motions, and tones during interactions.

ThingDef.label: Econo-Save BrainBlast™
ThingDef.description: Injects nanites that slightly improve learning speed.

ThingDef.label: Smart-Smart implant
ThingDef.description: There is no strength without suffering. This implant can be installed on all body parts. It is cheap and abundant. It requires no medical skill. But it is incredibly difficult to install.

ThingDef.label: malfunctioning genius implant
ThingDef.description: This genius implant was manufactured incorrectly and has several downsides. It's easier to install but less in-tune with the user. Notably, it causes the user to eat more, work slower, and require more recreation.

ThingDef.label: production medical implant
ThingDef.description: Another coveted implant bestowed on the world by the Vacuous and then downgraded to be feasible for mass manufacture. This implant dramatically improves medical knowledge. It was reportedly made by trapping the consciousness of a brilliant once-utilitarian doctor and then slowly harvesting relevant brain material and using healing implants to grow the affected brain areas back.\nIt is designed to be easy to install even for relatively unskilled doctors.

ThingDef.label: production genius implant
ThingDef.description: One of the most coveted implants currently in mass production. It improves thinking speed and IQ regardless of passion. This implant's schematics was bestowed on an outlander nation after they met the Vacuous subject quota for the first time. The nation rose to prominence and became the largest economy on the planet just a year after production of this implant began. Unfortunately, the Vacuous learned of a government conspiracy to produce extra implants and sell them on the black market, resulting in the total obliteration of the nation two hours later. Survivors still speak of this implant in whispered tones.

ThingDef.label: production research implant
ThingDef.description: Another coveted implant bestowed on the world by the Vacuous and then downgraded to be feasible for mass manufacture. This implant dramatically accelerates research speed.

ThingDef.label: prototype neuron welder implant
ThingDef.description: An incredibly powerful knowledge implant that warps the user's mind by providing extreme mental stimulus. It was found on a genius engineer who had run to his demise by striking an antigrain warhead. Despite the grisly fate, the implant remains undamaged. However, it is very difficult to install safely.
